question: Can I register my thesis with 118 credits?

body.answer: 5.3 Thesis registration: Students may register a thesis when they have at least 120 accumulated credits and a cumulative GPA of at least 2.0. Registration opens in week 1 and closes in week 3 of the semester.
3 Student card replacement: A lost student card can be replaced at Student Affairs (room I.102). The replacement fee is 50,000 VND and the new card is ready in 3 working days.
